name: rtx
_comment_rtx: RTX 5060 Ti (sm_120, 16 GB) on host. Layer-split COMBINED head for 27B. Peer always reserved. The per-model config (split-mode=layer, tensor-split=25/40) is in ModelRegistry keyed by `model_alias: dense-27b-q5` (Phase 2a, ddvnguyen/llama.cpp#36).

name: rtx3060
_comment_rtx3060: RTX 3060 (sm_86, 12 GB) on host. Peer-only engine, 0 slots (MultiEngineRouter treats slots=0 as 'implicitly available' for COMBINED). Dedicated RPC backend for head.
_design_gap_dual_role: The 3060 is locked as a dedicated COMBINED peer (slots=0). Future dual-role: let it solo-run small models (vision, audio, embeddings) when the 27B is idle, then switch to COMBINED peer when the dense model is active. Current MultiEngineRouter.Select skips IsFree for peer-only workers (Slots == 0), which is correct today but has no priority/preemption — a solo task on the 3060 would starve an incoming COMBINED request rather than draining the solo queue. P100 is a separate pool (p99 priority for fallback only), so no cross-contamination with 3060.

name: p100
_comment_p100: Tesla P100 (sm_60, 16 GB) KVM VM. Only picked when no Dense worker is available (de-prioritized with 999). Cross-model guard prevents 35B<->27B KV restore by hash mismatch.
